title: Faceless Appeals before CIT(A): Drafting Form 35 Grounds and Statement of Facts
summary: Strategic formulation of grounds of appeal, rebuttal submissions, and video conference advocacy before NFAC.
body:
Filing an appeal before the Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals) under the Faceless Appeal Scheme requires crisp legal structuring.

Formulation Strategy for Form 35:
1. Grounds of Appeal: Draft clear, un-convoluted questions of law and fact.
2. Statement of Facts: Chronologically detail assessment errors and overlooked evidence.
3. Additional Evidence under Rule 46A: File applications proving why records could not be produced earlier.

All submissions must be uploaded digitally via the e-Filing portal within 30 days. Contact our [Uttarpara & Konnagar Desk](/locations/uttarpara-konnagar) for legal representation.
